reason: A proposes a specific, physically plausible alumina-forming mechanism with measurable kinetics, subsurface Al depletion, phase analysis, and a clear falsification test, and it is directly supported by prior observations in the named alloy. Although its comparison should independently control Al content and BCC phase fraction—and its appeal to generic “sluggish diffusion” is questionable—it is substantially better grounded and less vague than B’s unsupported entropy-based claim of synergistic mixed-oxide protection.
